name: tcc-comparador-precos
description: Atalhos para iniciar backend e frontend do comparador de precos.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.test:core: node --test scrapers/reliability.test.js frontend/src/services/api.test.js frontend/src/services/comparison.test.js backend/services/adminAuth.test.js backend/services/collectionRunner.test.js backend/services/canonicalProducts.test.mjs backend/services/batchWriter.test.js backend/services/catalogQuery.test.js backend/services/comparisonCategories.test.js backend/services/importProducts.test.js scrapers/retry.test.js
